commands.name: fallow
commands.summary: Run Fallow across the monorepo with per-project attribution
commands.description: Two-pass Fallow scan (monorepo-aware root pass + per-project dependency hygiene), rolled up per Rush project (rush.json is the source of truth) as JSON + Markdown. Reporting only. This plugin must be installed in an autoinstaller named "rush-plugins".

commands.name: fallow-mcp
commands.description: Thin exec passthrough to the fallow-mcp binary bundled with the pinned fallow version. Rush global commands do not take positional arguments, so `rush fallow mcp` is spelled `rush fallow-mcp`. Wiring snippet: HERMES-WIRING.md in @butshouldwe/fallow-rush.

parameters.description: Only report issues in files changed since this git ref (passed through to fallow).
Narrow to the named Rush project(s).

Report directory (default: common/temp/fallow-rush). A scoped run (--project/--changed-since) that would overwrite a report recorded for a different project scope refuses unless --out is given explicitly.
Deprecated alias of --out; errors if both are given.
Exit 3 when any attributed finding or unsupported Fallow category exists.
Print the rollup JSON on stdout.
